jsonc-comments.file: SchDoc file to create, relative to this config file unless absolute.
jsonc-comments.sheet_style: Schematic sheet style. Options: Altium SheetStyle enum name or native enum id.
jsonc-comments.template: Optional SchDot template file to copy settings from.
jsonc-comments.apply_template_visual_sheet_settings: Whether to copy visual sheet settings from the template.
jsonc-comments.custom_sheet_mils: Optional explicit sheet size in mils.
